build_snowflake_config: build a SnowflakeBaseConfig instance to map OpenAI-compatible parameters for Snowflake API calls
test_validate_environment: test validate_environment to construct proper authorization headers for Snowflake REST API requests
create_get_supported_params: create a call to get_supported_openai_params to retrieve the list of supported OpenAI parameters for a Snowflake model
run_map_openai_params: run map_openai_params to filter non-default params and merge supported ones into optional params
run_get_api_base: run _get_api_base to derive the Snowflake API base URL from account_id or provided api_base
